name: Entity Association Menu
description: Create and manage menu and breadcrumbs for association entities.
project_description: Submodule of Entity Association. Gives each association its own navigation menu (and breadcrumb) whose items are stored in a dedicated database table rather than as core menu links. Items may point at an associated entity (auto-tracked as content is added/removed), a routed internal path, or an external URI. Editors manage a per-association menu at /association/{association}/menu (gated by association manage access plus an 'access association menu management' permission); the Association display block can render the menu. Provides a menu storage manager, a menu builder that renders via the core 'menu' theme with per-item route access checks, events for altering links, and a Toolshed third-party config integration for default-enabled tags.
